Point = 10.167 - 0.007 = 10.160 million. Interval method = realized same-row change dispersion; 80% half-width = 1.28*sigma = 1.28*0.252 = 0.322 million, so bounds are 10.160 - 0.322 = 9.838 and 10.160 + 0.322 = 10.482 million.
